execution_policy.authority_rule: This planning artifact grants no additional authority and does not revoke or require renewed permission for existing explicit user authorizations/delegations. This task performs only the two planning deliverables.
execution_policy.verification_prefix: Source /workspace/guild-runtime/activate.sh for non-login shells; prefix tool commands with PATH=/workspace/guild-runtime/bin:$PATH.
execution_policy.future_commands: All quest verification entries are planned checks, not results. Use package scripts after their owning quest exists; live setup and exact host evidence are separate gates.
execution_policy.phase_policy: Preserve source incremental usable outcomes. Implement/review one phase outcome at a time; dependency edges represent actual consumed artifacts/contracts/accepted gates, not source order. Local work may prepare independent later-phase modules without claiming that phase accepted.
execution_policy.test_policy: No Docker/Guild Trials dependency. Disposable native/managed PostgreSQL and qualified native host networking; controlled fixture egress never weakens production policy. One serialized browser runner; no browser installation.

assumptions: Planning only: base has README.md and docs/implementation-plan.md; module paths are proposed exact ownership boundaries, not existing implementation.

The user explicitly selects direct execution without Guild/Docker dependency for this run. Host-native isolation must satisfy the source security requirements; this is a deployment-process adaptation, not an egress waiver.
No hosting vendor, model ID, credential, Auth method, rate/token ceiling not fixed in source or deployment resource value is invented. Owner choices are setup gates.
Node22 and patched supported Next15 remain source targets. If vendor support is unsuitable at implementation time, resolve the concrete runtime decision before launch.
All implementation size/model recommendations are estimates; no measured token/cost or passing application test is claimed.
Use native forms, straightforward functions/SQL and existing PostgreSQL scrape_jobs; no generic form engine, new queue, state framework, search index or recurring service proliferation.

Before future implementation, inspect current repository instructions/status and reconcile source changes. This artifact grants no additional authority; existing explicit user authorizations and delegated publication/merge authority persist. No implementation, commit or external change is performed by this planning task.
Future browser/port-bound checks use one configured exclusive wrapper with a wall-clock cap, no browser installation; exact process IDs only and test-owned disposable resources.
No registered author email is configured by this planning artifact. Establish real commit identity only when commits become authorized; this does not block reading or planning.

requirements.description: One Next15/Node22 app, persistent Node worker, Supabase/Auth, hooks/context/Tailwind/BEM; direct execution and no extra queue
Five singleton kinds and separate people/offerings; stable IDs, defaults and no destructive history
Owner/editor/viewer and unavailable cross-company HTTP/RPC/table and JSON references
Dedicated non-login owner, fixed search_path, restricted worker functions, no renderer secrets/authority spoofing
Verified session, CSRF/origin validation, no-store tenant data and body/rate limits
Atomic idempotent first owner, metadata generation, last-owner concurrent protection and read-preserving owner archive
10 docs/depth2/3 HTTP/1 render/500ms/15s/25s/5min/2MiB/100k chars/15MiB; max25/depth3/candidates200
Normalization, bare/www offline suffix scope, exact subdomain, effective root/redirect aliases and canonical metadata only
Identifiable robots per origin, finite status/retry/rate handling, no auth/CAPTCHA/form bypass
SKIP LOCKED, 60s lease/15s heartbeat, unexpired token fences, <=3 attempts, one active company/claimed worker job
Checkpoint/source reuse, atomic idempotent all-or-nothing empty-company first import; existing/human draft stays proposal-only
Cancelled job retains captures without partial import; removed requester/archive blocks processing/finalization
Real persisted counts and stage, 2s active polling/backoff/terminal stop, company/job URL recovery
All A/AAAA global-only, mixed/special/mapped denial, DNS-rebinding pinning and TLS/SNI, five manually checked redirects
Every renderer/fetch/asset connection forced through public-only proxy; deny direct DNS/TCP/UDP/QUIC/internal access even if hooks bypassed
Private authenticated secret-free separate renderer; fresh context, sandbox/resources, no SW/WebRTC/WS/download, CDN-only asset exception
Bounded sanitized plain text/segments, observed metadata/JSONLD/links/CTA/style, finalize only after render, immutable source/hash
Tool-free sanitized untrusted envelope, Responses strict Zod output then semantic checks, bounded task/retry and honest refusal/incomplete failures
Identical facts combine evidence, differing candidates conflict; no confidence/recency preference or same-name auto-merge
All 41 fields attempted, strict nested values, origin field permissions, null/[] defaults and exactly-once coverage independent of review
No inferred legal/founding/headquarters/exact employees/gender; website-only outlook, lossless numeric pricing and raw employee wording
Separate CSS-declared/loaded/computed fonts, RGB/HSL/alpha colors/brand role, logo context and no SVG export
Stable escaped @UUID pointers, repeatable IDs/reorder/removed IDs, every populated factual leaf compatible claim except metadata IDs
Same-company captured sources, URL/time/quote/technical identity, claim DAG/support and separate historical supersedes references
Explicit save/review/clear/reject/revert append revisions, edit resets approval, approval retains origin and user correction supersedes original quote
Material conflict decision before approve; singleton/person/offering review units, unknowns eligible and rejection retains defaults/coverage
Current/proposed evidence, selected apply at expected current revision and fresh conflicts; dismiss decision only, no automatic overwrite
Revision operation UUID/body check under company lock; job/snapshot relational keys and 409 stale edits preserve unsaved input
Observed author/date or title/n.d., deterministic year suffix, full reference/retrieval semantics and honest user/generated/inferred labels
Every factual leaf evidence, interactive hover/focus/tap popover/drawer, Escape/outside dismissal, safe escaped text/links/logo handling
Seven tabs/review coverage, all crawl/save/stale/conflict/review/publication states, viewer controls and unsaved-warning persistence
Company lock, expected generation, all current entries resolved, >=1 approved, frozen manifest/default assembly and atomic version counter
Frozen company/source citation metadata, canonical UTF8 payload/hash, stable item order, safe name and stored-version-only read/download; no old-schema migration
Latest snapshot/draft selector, cards/table/detail/evidence, local scoped search/section-origin-review-coverage filters
Deterministic HTML/CSS/JSONLD and recorded models, disposable DB, isolated fixture egress, proportional boundary cases and one E2E
Auth/Supabase/model/private renderer config, patched pinned runtime, support/TLS/connections/terms, secrets/backup/restart/health and real-host proof
Real company scrape to all-category evidenced review/immutable snapshot/download with tenant/viewer protection and honest undisclosed facts
